entries.zh: 做主主持、恒勤照管（殷勤不懈）
entries.en: to preside over and attend to constantly; to take charge of as master
entries.notes: 音写栏中段为单字母缩写“y.”且一处声调污损（T99），据汉字“主”与官话对音 chù 定为主持照管义

entries.zh: 目头目尾、处处留神照看（以眼照管）
entries.en: to keep watch with attentive eyes; to look after everything
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏与闽南音写栏皆空缺，汉字疑为“龜力/電力”，仅存官话对音 xiêng lī，无从定夺语义

entries.zh: 警醒勤勉、小心提防（警惕不懈）
entries.en: careful and vigilant; watchfully diligent
entries.notes: 汉字首字存疑（龜/電），官话对音 xièng mièn 与音写 cuān sīn 未能完全互证，据西语 Cuidadoso Vigilante 与“勉”字推断为勤勉警惕义

entries.zh: 照管吏事职司、留心公务
entries.en: to attend to official duties; to care for one's office
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺仅存 cuidar，据汉字“吏司”与音写 lŷ sū 推断为照管职司公务义

entries.en: to look after protectively; to shelter and care for
entries.notes: 音写栏一处声调污损（T99），且官话对音 cān cǔ 更近“看顧”而汉字栏作“省顧”，据西语 amparando 定为照拂护持义

entries.zh: 任凭、听任（任伊：由他自便，随他怎样）
entries.en: to let (him/it) be; to allow at will, to leave to its own way
entries.notes: 西语词头后半 como el celebre guſa（或为 gusano 之截断，喻义未详）未能完全解明，以汉字“任伊”与音写为准

entries.zh: 挂念、悬心惦记（心悬放不下）
entries.en: to be anxious and concerned; to miss someone, to be in suspense
to be concerned about; to have care for

entries.zh: 爱顾、眷顾疼惜（照管不舍）
entries.en: to cherish and look after; to care for with affection
entries.notes: 音写与官话对音首音节均作 cuān（近“關/眷顧”），与汉字“愛”略有出入，四栏语义同指照管，不碍释义

entries.zh: 掌世界、执掌天下（照管家业天地）
entries.en: to hold the world in one's charge; to govern worldly affairs
entries.notes: 官话对音末字声调污损（T99），西语 hacienda, raíces 与“掌世界”对应欠明，据汉字与音写定为执掌世界义

entries.en: to grasp and hold firmly; to keep control of
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏中字残缺，据汉字“把持”与官话对音 pà chy 定为把持义

entries.en: to grasp; to hold in hand
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏中字残缺，据汉字“執持”与官话对音 chĭt chŷ 定为执持义

entries.zh: 执守、持守不懈（执而守之）
entries.en: to hold fast and keep; to observe firmly
to hold or keep a contract, a deed in hand
to hold fast; to keep steady and fixed
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏中字残缺，据汉字“把定”与官话对音 pà têng 定为持定义

entries.en: to preserve oneself; to keep oneself safe and whole
to nurse one's health; to care for the body
to nurse and recuperate; to restore health by care
entries.notes: 官话对音首字声调污损（T99），据汉字“調理”与音写 tiaū ý 及西语 cuidar de la salud 定为调理将养义

entries.en: to take care of oneself; to take good care (as a parting wish)

entries.zh: 周旋、应酬交际（与人接洽、从中周全其事）
entries.en: to socialize and deal with people; to manage an affair tactfully
entries.notes: 西语词头 haftaccarlo 拼写异常（疑为 haber de hacerlo 之类缩略），据汉字“周旋”与音写 chiū guān 定为应酬周旋义

entries.zh: 治家、当家料理自家家计（各人照管自家门户，井然有序）
entries.en: to keep one's own house; to look after one's own affairs in an orderly way
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏全残，西语栏中段残缺，汉字疑为“卒意/率意”，仅存官话对音 guī ý，无从定夺语义
